protocols.title: EPO (Erythropoietin, 3000 IU) Dosage Protocol — source reference
protocols.purpose: Individual-page schedule and handling details, transcribed as a research/educational reference
protocols.evidenceNotes: Secondary commercial source; these are the page's statements, not independently verified clinical guidance. No administration dose is provided. Clinical recombinant EPO is individualized and titrated by a clinician to the lowest hemoglobin avoiding transfusion; misuse carries serious risks. Page's 3000 IU in 1 mL is concentration math only.
